caption:
Neapolitan crust needs roughly 750°F at the stone. Most countertop ovens cap at about 12-inch pizzas. Both AI models pick the same oven, the Breville Smart Oven Pizzaiolo. Frozen pizza on a budget has its own pick: 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Can an indoor oven make Neapolitan pizza? What to check
